column4: Continue the first reference: identical locked camera, lectern, book and background. The page has now been turned over: the leaf that was pinched lies flat on the LEFT side covering the old left page, with a slightly curled edge, and a fresh blank page is revealed on the right. The white-gloved hand with the ruffled cuff and orange sleeve has let go and is lifting away at the upper left, fingertips near the corner of the turned page, five clear fingers. All pages stay blank, no text. Nothing else changes.
